confidence_notes: Restaurant, coffee, and beer anchors are bounded by Killarney and Ireland cost-of-living aggregates. Cocktail and wine prices are less certain and estimated in relation to local beer prices and hotel-bar menus. Accommodation anchors are holistic summer estimates; no booking listings were inspected.
comparable_city_reasoning: Food and drink estimates use Killarney city-level aggregates cross-checked against Ireland and nearby Cork. Accommodation reflects Killarney's summer tourism demand.
